Package io.github.jspinak.brobot.core.location

Class ElementLocator.LocateRequest

java.lang.Object
io.github.jspinak.brobot.core.location.ElementLocator.LocateRequest
Enclosing interface:
ElementLocator
public static class ElementLocator.LocateRequest extends Object
Request object for element location operations. Encapsulates all parameters needed for locating elements, providing a clean and extensible API.
